label: thm.ideal.membership
title: Derivative and zero-substitution characterization of multilinear vanishing-ideal membership
difficulty_reason: The structured membership criterion requires a multilinearity-preserving fixed-core reduction and a witness-selection argument that extracts suitable disjoint derivative and zero-substitution sets. The authors prove necessity and sufficiency through the full Zoom Lemma, enlarged-core construction and isolation of a top-degree monomial in Section5, rather than merely invoking general ideal membership, so this is above ordinary qualification-level algebra.
review_note: Selected Theorem1.8 exactly. Full original Sections1–9 retained, including the complete Zoom Lemma and rational-function helper, Section5 multilinearity-preserving enlarged-core reduction and witness isolation, and the final proof2150–2155. General generating-set Theorem1.3 is prerequisite context, not a substitute for the selected derivative criterion. This is distinct from647/ROABP hitting; unqueued1.10 is complementary support only.
